_note: Project types drive qualification and the 'configure' action. Add a new service by adding an entry here (and an offer in offers.json). Ids must match the pricing configurator types.

projectTypes.label: Portfolio website
qualificationQuestions: What do you want the portfolio to showcase?
How many pages do you roughly need?
Do you need it in more than one language?

projectTypes.label: Showcase / vitrine website
projectTypes.description: A site presenting a business, its services or catalogue, without online purchase.
qualificationQuestions: Do you want visitors to only browse (catalogue / presentation) or to buy online?
Roughly how many pages do you need?
Do you need to update content yourself?

projectTypes.label: Business website
projectTypes.description: A website for a company or independent professional.
qualificationQuestions: What should the website help your business do (get contacts, present services, book appointments)?
Roughly how many pages do you need?
Do you need specific integrations?

projectTypes.label: Corporate website
projectTypes.description: A larger, more structured company website.
qualificationQuestions: How many sections or pages do you expect?
Do you need several languages?
Do you need to connect other tools or systems?

projectTypes.label: E-commerce website
projectTypes.description: An online store where customers buy directly.
qualificationQuestions: Do you want customers to buy directly online?
Do you want to manage products yourself?
Do you need online payment?
Do you need delivery company integration?
Do you prefer a simpler template-based solution or a fully custom one?
Do you have specific integrations in mind?
Roughly how many pages do you need?

projectTypes.label: CRM / management tool
projectTypes.description: A tool to manage customers, orders or internal processes.
qualificationQuestions: What do you need to manage (customers, orders, stock, appointments)?
How many people will use it?
Do you need to connect it to other tools?

projectTypes.label: Custom web application
projectTypes.description: A web application built around specific requirements.
qualificationQuestions: What is the main thing the application must do?
Who will use it?
Do you need user accounts or integrations?
